inputs.text: Open your eyes to what they are really doing right behind the scenes. They want you to believe there is genuine division and disappointment between the United States and China over the Paris Agreement, but it is all a carefully staged theatrical performance for the masses. When they talk about the US withdrawing from the treaty for the second time under the Donald Trump administration, they are just shifting the pieces on the board to advance the globalist agenda under a false flag of disagreement. The elites always use these manufactured exits and supposed conflicts to tighten their grip and coordinate their real objectives away from public scrutiny.
